title: Cindersnap Gloves

sources.title: Protection from Missiles
markers: | description = Amplify your reflexes to better contend with incoming missiles. [[Ranged Attack|Ranged weapon attacks]] against you have {{Disadvantage}}, and their damage is halved.

summary: Use an Action once per Short Rest to protect yourself for 10 turns. Ranged weapon attacks against you have Disadvantage and deal half damage.
